responsibility: This definition module declares GNU Modula-2’s SYSTEM interface, the low-level compiler/runtime boundary for target-dependent primitive types and builtin operations. It exports core machine constants such as BITSPERBYTE and BYTESPERWORD, the target-sized scalar and address types inserted by configuration, and compiler-known procedures like ADR, TSIZE, ROTATE, SHIFT, THROW, and TBITSIZE; it also declares the runtime helpers used when the compiler must implement shifts and rotates on multi-word BITSET values rather than inlining them.
same_name_distinction: Interface half of the SYSTEM pair: it exposes target-dependent constants, inserted primitive types, compiler-known operations such as ADR/TSIZE/SHIFT/ROTATE/THROW/TBITSIZE, and declares the helper entry points for large BITSET shifts and rotates that the sibling module implements.
